title: Clips from my neon Rampart inspired game
author: Wladaaaaa
selftext:
Resharing from Indidev my version of rampart remake. Single player with AI, local couch multiplayer and online MP. 

What are your impressions. 

I think I will need month or two to finish the game

comments.author: master619
comments.body: Nice! Which game engine did you use? And which main AI for the code? (Claude code, codex,...)?

replies.author: Wladaaaaa
replies.body:
Unity version 6. Coded with claude code from version 4.5 opus  to now 4.8.
Also i'm software engineer for 18 years but without unity expirience so claude helped a lot

replies.author: master619
replies.body: Thanks! How was the automation testing/debugging experience, if you had those at all? Does Unity provide useful mcps or tools for Claude code to hook into / see the game screen structurely, or best it could do is take a screenshot every time to analyze?

replies.author: Wladaaaaa
replies.body:
Unit test where possible, written with claude code. I have around 600 unit tests. Manual testing done by me by playing the game.  

Also I used UnityMCP in order to enable the access to unity editor to a claude code.  It is good MCP, regulary maintained and it works quite nice.

Also I used MCP for Blender for some basic models creation, and models editting. This was not perfect, but it helped. Claude code can do some basic editing and exporting models.
